title: A min macro
description:
Write a macro `min_of!` that returns the smallest of one or more expressions, each evaluated exactly once:

```rust
min_of!(7)              // 7
min_of!(3, 9, -4, 7)    // -4
min_of!(2.5, 1.5)       // 1.5
```
hints: Two rules: one expression is the answer by itself; otherwise take the first, recurse on the rest with `min_of!($($rest),+)`, and keep the smaller.
Store each value in a `let` before comparing: writing `if $x < ... { $x }` would evaluate `$x` twice.
